entries.en: a row or line of things placed one after another (ringlera); linked in succession
a row, rank or line; array
in continuous succession, one after another without break
entries.notes: R 栏第三音节污损难辨（T99），词形依 H「相」＋M「連續」定为「相連續」

entries.en: arranged or ranged in a row, side by side

entries.notes: R 栏残损、声调多不可辨（[残]/T99）；肾义据 L「Riñones」与 H/M「腰子」互证

entries.en: the loin bone, bone of the lower back

entries.zh: 港；水道、河流，兼指港湾与狭窄水道（海峡）
entries.en: a river or waterway; a harbor, or a narrow channel / strait
a mountain stream, a brook in a ravine
the mouth of a river (boca del río); harbor mouth, port entrance
entries.notes: R 栏末混入下页页首错字「La VOCABULRIO」，系印刷抓词混入，不入释义

entries.en: a dry creek, dried-up stream bed (río seco)
entries.notes: R 栏残损且后两音节不可辨（[残]/T99）；干溪义据 L「rio seco」与 H「溪」M「乾」互证

entries.zh: 黄河；浩荡大河（西语 río caudaloso 之译例）
entries.en: a mighty, flood-swollen river (río caudaloso); given as the Yellow River
entries.notes: R 栏保留西语 caudaloso 未译，释义以汉字「黄河」为准

entries.en: wealth, riches (of gold, silver, and the like)
entries.notes: 「v.gal.」按当时词典惯例推为 verbi gratia（例如）之缩写；词义由 L/H/R 三栏互证

entries.zh: 贝；贝壳、货贝（古以贝为财）
entries.en: cowrie, shell (counted among treasures, shell-money of old)
entries.notes: 西语词头栏空白，承上 Riqueza 条为并列汉字；M 栏空白，据 H「貝」与 R「gue」定为贝义

entries.en: treasure, riches of gold and silver
